prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was seen for neck strain. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of care, the patient completed 18 visits consisting of physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Cervical imaging and clinical examination findings clearly support the diagnosis of cervical strain. The records also show prior treatment to the same region within the past two years. That earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints, and this has been considered in the overall assessment. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate charges for the same services. At discharge, the patient was improved with residual stiffness on extended positioning, and a home program was provided for continued self-management.
